ui.settings.model.default_effort.label.role: Label above the default-effort picker in Model settings
ui.settings.model.default_effort.label.tone: Plain noun phrase naming what is stored, in the same register as the Hosting provider and Model labels beside it.
ui.settings.model.default_effort.label.length: One label line, a few words. English is 14 characters.
ui.settings.model.default_effort.label.note: Sits directly under the Model picker. The value is the reasoning-effort level a NEW conversation starts at. Sentence case.

ui.settings.model.default_effort.placeho.role: Empty-field hint inside the default-effort picker
ui.settings.model.default_effort.placeho.length: Clipped at the field width (~24-40 characters). English is 22 characters.
ui.settings.model.default_effort.placeho.note: Shown before a value is shown; the field is a chooser, not free text.

ui.settings.model.default_effort.busy.role: Accessible busy label while the default effort is being saved
ui.settings.model.default_effort.busy.note: Replaces the chevron with a spinner. Screen readers hear it; sighted readers see the spinner only.

ui.settings.model.default_effort.model_d.role: The unset row in the default-effort picker
ui.settings.model.default_effort.model_d.tone: Plain noun phrase; it names the absence of an opinion rather than a level.
ui.settings.model.default_effort.model_d.length: One row label beside level names such as High or Medium. English is 13 characters.
ui.settings.model.default_effort.model_d.note: Selecting it stores an empty value, which means new conversations use whatever level the model itself resolves. It must never be described as a level.

ui.settings.model.default_effort.model_d.role: Description under the Model default row
ui.settings.model.default_effort.model_d.tone: Matter-of-fact statement of what will run.
ui.settings.model.default_effort.model_d.length: One short sentence under a row. English is 30 characters plus the level name.
ui.settings.model.default_effort.model_d.note: Shown only when the backend reported a resolved level for the selected model.

placeholders.level: A level name such as High, Medium or Low, already title-cased for display. Insert as given.

ui.settings.model.default_effort.helper_.role: Helper line under the default-effort picker when a ladder is offerable
ui.settings.model.default_effort.helper_.tone: Helpful explanation in second person; states scope, not a promise.
ui.settings.model.default_effort.helper_.length: Wrapping helper paragraph under the field. English is 92 characters.
ui.settings.model.default_effort.helper_.note: Also tells the reader what "Model default" means without repeating the level.

ui.settings.model.default_effort.loading.role: Helper line while the backend resolves the selected model's effort ladder
ui.settings.model.default_effort.loading.tone: Quiet status sentence, no spinner in the copy.
ui.settings.model.default_effort.loading.length: One helper line. English is 40 characters.
ui.settings.model.default_effort.loading.note: The control is disabled while this is shown.

ui.settings.model.default_effort.error.role: Helper line when the model's effort ladder could not be read
ui.settings.model.default_effort.error.tone: Plain statement of the failure; no blame, no raw exception.
ui.settings.model.default_effort.error.length: One helper line. English is 47 characters.
ui.settings.model.default_effort.error.note: No list of levels is offered in this state.

ui.settings.model.default_effort.no_mode.role: Helper line when no hosting or model is configured
ui.settings.model.default_effort.no_mode.length: One helper line. English is 48 characters.
ui.settings.model.default_effort.no_mode.note: The control is disabled; the reader chooses a model in the row above.

ui.settings.model.default_effort.no_home.role: Helper line when the app has not reported a home directory
ui.settings.model.default_effort.no_home.tone: Plain statement of a wait, not an error.
ui.settings.model.default_effort.no_home.length: One helper line. English is 77 characters.
ui.settings.model.default_effort.no_home.note: The picker issues no preview request until a home directory is known.

ui.settings.model.default_effort.setting.role: Helper line while the stored default effort is being read
ui.settings.model.default_effort.setting.length: One helper line. English is 39 characters.
ui.settings.model.default_effort.setting.note: Distinct from the model-ladder read: this one is the saved value from the settings registry.

ui.settings.model.default_effort.setting.role: Helper line when the stored default effort could not be read
ui.settings.model.default_effort.setting.length: One helper line. English is 42 characters.
ui.settings.model.default_effort.setting.note: The chooser is disabled; a write here could overwrite a value the app could not see.

ui.settings.model.default_effort.unresol.role: Helper line when the model's spec is not resolved yet
ui.settings.model.default_effort.unresol.length: One helper line. English is 49 characters.
ui.settings.model.default_effort.unresol.note: Same fact the composer's effort picker states: an unresolved spec is not a model without levels.

ui.settings.model.default_effort.empty.role: Helper line when the model's ladder is known to be empty
ui.settings.model.default_effort.empty.tone: Plain statement; no advice to pick another model in Settings.
ui.settings.model.default_effort.empty.length: One helper line. English is 39 characters.
ui.settings.model.default_effort.empty.note: Reuses the composer's wording so the two surfaces describe one fact the same way.

ui.settings.model.default_effort.one_lev.role: Helper line when the model's ladder has exactly one rung
ui.settings.model.default_effort.one_lev.tone: Matter-of-fact; it states there is no choice.
ui.settings.model.default_effort.one_lev.length: One helper line. English is 45 characters plus the level name.
ui.settings.model.default_effort.one_lev.note: The control is disabled in this state rather than pretending to offer a choice.

placeholders.level: The single level name, already title-cased for display. Insert as given.

ui.settings.model.default_effort.one_lev.role: Helper line under the disabled one-outcome default-effort picker when the model's only value is the auto sentinel
ui.settings.model.default_effort.one_lev.tone: Matter-of-fact delegation: the model decides, the reader has no level to choose.
ui.settings.model.default_effort.one_lev.length: Wrapping helper paragraph under the field. English is 76 characters.
ui.settings.model.default_effort.one_lev.note: Replaces the one-level sentence for the `auto` sentinel only. `auto` is the registry's LABEL for the empty value (no opinion), not a level, so this sentence must never call it a level; a real single rung keeps "This model offers one effort level: {level}."

ui.settings.model.default_effort.clamped.role: Announcement at the Default effort row after a model switch rewrote the stored level
ui.settings.model.default_effort.clamped.tone: Matter-of-fact statement of what happened and what is now in force; it explains a value the reader did not choose.
ui.settings.model.default_effort.clamped.length: One line under the helper. English is 47 characters plus two level names and the model name.
ui.settings.model.default_effort.clamped.note: Shown in a polite live region after the clamp write succeeds, and only then. The level is named as the reader saw it, in the app's title case; the model is the preview's display name, or its id when it has none.

placeholders.level: The stored level that the new model does not offer, already title-cased for display.
placeholders.model: The selected model's display name, or its id when it reports none.
placeholders.resolved: The level now stored, already title-cased for display.

ui.settings.model.default_effort.clamped.role: Same announcement when the rewrite clears the value instead of naming a level
ui.settings.model.default_effort.clamped.tone: Matter-of-fact; it names the unset row rather than inventing a level.
ui.settings.model.default_effort.clamped.length: One line under the helper. English is 55 characters plus the level name and the model name.
ui.settings.model.default_effort.clamped.note: Used when the backend resolves no level for the new model, so the clamp writes the empty value. "Model default" is the row's own name for that value.

placeholders.level: The stored level that the new model does not offer, already title-cased for display.
placeholders.model: The selected model's display name, or its id when it reports none.

ui.settings.model.default_effort.save_fa.role: Sentence beside the picker after a failed save
ui.settings.model.default_effort.save_fa.tone: Plain statement of the failure; the previous value is still shown.
ui.settings.model.default_effort.save_fa.length: One line under the helper. English is 33 characters.
ui.settings.model.default_effort.save_fa.note: Never resets the control silently: the stored value stays on screen and this says why the new one did not take.
